subject: Authoring pipeline + review queue, Settings, export-all
body: Brief: docs/segments/21-authoring-settings.md. Own cloud session. Post your day-one contracts on the ledger; coordinate with every owner before touching their files; dependencies still in progress (S12b, S13, S14 and this wave's siblings) — build on their public APIs/contracts and wire the rest as they land. Follow docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md + the integration gate (--test-cmd); shared e2e helpers settle()/quiet()/trackApi().
